result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make it so that **every person has genuine access to the knowledge and critical thinking skills they need to understand the world and make informed choices.**

Not just schooling, but the ability to question, verify, and think clearly—paired with the resources (time, safety, connectivity, language) to actually use that ability.

Why this one lever? Because so many other problems persist simply because people are kept in the dark, flooded with misinformation, or lack the tools to coordinate solutions. A world where populations can reliably distinguish evidence from manipulation, understand their own health, rights, and environment, and hold power accountable would see better outcomes in health, governance, climate, and justice. It doesn’t solve everything automatically, but it creates the conditions for people to solve more things themselves.

What about you—what’s your one change?
